attributes.description:
Dictionary containing the information to sample the dataset. The keys
corresponds to the class labels from which to sample and the values
are the number of samples to sample.
attributes.name: sampling_strategy_

attributes.description:
Number of features in the input dataset.

.. versionadded:: 0.9
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during `fit`. Defined only when `X` has feature
names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 0.10
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Check inputs and statistics of the sampler.

methods.name: get_feature_names_out
methods.summary: Get output feature names for transformation.

methods.name: get_metadata_routing
methods.summary: Get metadata routing of this object.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

parameters.description:
The callable to use for the transformation. This will be passed the
same arguments as transform, with args and kwargs forwarded. If func is
None, then func will be the identity function.
parameters.name: func

parameters.description:
Whether sparse input are supported. By default, sparse inputs are
supported.
parameters.name: accept_sparse

parameters.description:
Whether or not to bypass the validation of ``X`` and ``y``. Turning-off
validation allows to use the ``FunctionSampler`` with any type of
data.

.. versionadded:: 0.6
parameters.name: validate

summary: Construct a sampler from calling an arbitrary callable.
